title: Nutritious Kenyan Meat Stew
description: A pungent and juicy Kenyan dish featuring lard, this stew is perfect for a midnight craving and is diabetic-friendly, made with a variety of ingredients and cooked to perfection in a pressure cooker.
instructions: Heat the lard in a large pressure cooker over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the beef to the pressure cooker and cook until it is browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the potato, carrot, tomato, beef broth, salt, and black pepper to the pressure cooker.
Close the lid of the pressure cooker and bring the stew to high pressure.
Reduce the heat to low and cook for 30 minutes.
Remove the pressure cooker from the heat and let the pressure release naturally.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
